== both-grantees
Request: {"GranteePrincipal": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/grantee", "GranteeServicePrincipal": "sqs.amazonaws.com", "RetiringPrincipal": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/grantee", "Constraints": {"SourceArn": "arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:queue"}}
HTTP 400 ValidationException
Cannot specify both GranteePrincipal and GranteeServicePrincipal.
== no-grantee
Request: {}
HTTP 400 ValidationException
Must include either GranteePrincipal or GranteeServicePrincipal.
== service-grantee-without-source-arn
Request: {"GranteeServicePrincipal": "sqs.amazonaws.com", "RetiringPrincipal": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/grantee"}
HTTP 400 ValidationException
Must include SourceArn constraint when GranteeServicePrincipal is supplied.
== service-grantee-without-retiring-principal
Request: {"GranteeServicePrincipal": "sqs.amazonaws.com", "Constraints": {"SourceArn": "arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:queue"}}
HTTP 400 ValidationException
RetiringServicePrincipal or RetiringPrincipal must be specified when GranteeServicePrincipal is supplied.
== both-retiring-principals
Request: {"GranteePrincipal": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/grantee", "RetiringPrincipal": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/grantee", "RetiringServicePrincipal": "sqs.amazonaws.com"}
HTTP 400 ValidationException
Cannot specify both RetiringPrincipal and RetiringServicePrincipal.
== source-arn-without-account

1 validation error detected: Value 'arn:aws:s3:::fc-nonexistent-probe-bucket' at 'constraints.sourceArn' failed to satisfy constraint: Member must satisfy regular expression pattern: ^arn:aws[a-z0-9-]*:[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]*:[0-9]{12}:.+$
